name: SVP Capital Delivery (committee chair)
focus: Chairs the Capital Steering Committee. Asks where the program stands, which large projects need a decision, and what goes in the quarterly pack.

name: Capital Controller
focus: Asks whether forecasts reconcile to the ledger, whether the year's plan will be spent by December, and what moved since last month.

name: Director, Rate Case and Regulatory
focus: Asks which claimed projects will be in service inside the test year, how plant additions compare with the order, and what evidence backs a cost increase.

name: Project Controls Manager
focus: Asks which forecasts are stale, which project managers to chase, and which projects moved most since the last round.

name: Treasury and Funding
focus: Asks how much cash the program needs by month and how much of it is covered by loans and grants.

name: Utility President
focus: Asks how their utility's plan, spend and rate base additions compare with what the commission was told.

name: Compliance Manager
focus: Asks whether mandated work (PFAS treatment, lead service lines, consent orders) is on pace for its deadline.

name: Category Manager, Capital Works
focus: Asks how much capital spend goes through framework agreements, what the program is saving against its target, and which orders went off-framework.

name: Plant Accounting Manager
focus: Asks which projects are in service but still in CWIP, what has been unitized, and what depreciation and retirements the month booked.

name: Project Manager
focus: Asks where a single project stands against its approved budget, what is committed, and how much contingency is left.

name: Director, Engineering and Asset Management
focus: Asks which high-risk renewals are unfunded, how the plan ranks projects, and what moved between plan vintages.

name: Chief Financial Officer
focus: Asks what the program adds to rate base, how much it needs financed, and whether the year's capital will be spent.

name: Board Finance Committee
focus: Asks whether the five-year plan stays inside its envelope and what it means for customer rates.

name: Commission staff (data requests)
focus: Asks for the evidence behind the rate base: what is in service, what it cost, and why the cost was prudent.

name: Lender and funding agency liaison
focus: Asks how much eligible spend can be drawn this month and whether the compliance records are complete.

name: Regional Operations Director
focus: Asks when new plant comes into service in the region and which projects will disrupt operations.
